verdict.rationale: First-party docs show you can upload data files such as CSV, XLSX and JSON. Claude can then generate downloadable Excel, PowerPoint, Word and PDF files and produce reports with charts and visualizations, and the homepage advertises "Generate code and visualize data," with artifacts for visualizations. This covers the core outcome of charts and downloadable files from your data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Claude actually executes code (a sandbox or runtime) on the uploaded data, explicit evidence of computed numeric answers from analysis, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
